description: Knowledge graph edge. Substrate-native KG layer per ADR-2605190900. An edge is an RDF-style quad (subject, predicate, object|literal, context). Subjects and objects reference com.etzhayyim.kg.node records by at-uri or by nodeId. SPARQL semantics; OWL semantics NOT implied.

subject.description: Subject node reference. AT-URI of an com.etzhayyim.kg.node record, or a node.nodeId value.

predicate.description: Predicate token or IRI. Conventional short tokens: 'depends_on', 'related', 'supersedes', 'superseded_by', 'uses-lexicon', 'projects-from', 'anchored-at', 'owns', 'asserts', 'authoritative-for'. Full IRIs allowed for inter-graph alignment.

object.description: Object node reference (object-typed edge). AT-URI or nodeId. Mutually exclusive with 'literal' — exactly one of {object, literal} MUST be set.

literal.description: Literal value (literal-typed edge, e.g. 'has-version' -> '1.2.3'). Mutually exclusive with 'object' — exactly one of {object, literal} MUST be set.

weight.description: Optional numeric weight for weighted-graph algorithms. Scale 0-1000 (permille: weight/1000 = normalized 0.0-1.0). Per AT Protocol Lexicon v1: no float types; use integer with implied units.

context.description: Optional named-graph / provenance pointer. Typically the AT-URI of the record that asserts this edge (e.g. an ADR or a module manifest). Equivalent to the fourth term of an RDF quad.

source.description: Projection source, parallel to kg.node.source. Examples: 'deps.toml', 'adr-frontmatter', 'lexicon-refs', 'manual'.
